items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen in walks of 10 to 19 minutes. You walked after 1 of your scored meals, but it's too few to measure your own effect yet.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a rise in sugar, with dinners at 8-9 pm linked to a bigger rise than earlier dinners. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see how it affects you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.6 hours, which is a good start, and some studies suggest that longer overnight fasts might be linked to smaller rises in sugar. Adding an overnight fast to your routine might be something to try, but it's not proven to make a big difference yet.
